text:
Maya L: Quick sync — we need an audience mapping + counterclaim sprint for the launch comms. Goal: 1-line rebuttals for SDRs + 3x longer field snippets. Who can own?
Jules P: Which opponents are top priority? cloud infra providers, managed LLM APIs, or inference runtimes vendors?
Maya L: All three, but prioritize cloud infra & managed LLM APIs. Field reporting: customers keep asking 'why not the cloud provider endpoint' and 'how do you avoid model drift/cost surprises'.
Rohan S: Added a raw matrix in Drive: https://drive.redwood/cadence/audience-matrix - columns: persona, typical objection, impact. Core claims to map: "predictable throughput", "cost transparency", "same API across hosted/dedicated/private".
Avery K: Can we convert those into 30–40 char openers for SDRs? They need snackable lines for cold outreach.
Samir: From field: procurement always pushes SLA + data residency. Also we get "who owns tuning/quantization" Qs. Need price comps vs reserved cloud instances.
Jules P: Draft 1-line rebuttals (first pass):
```
- "Predictable throughput — reserved pools tuned for production, not bursty endpoints."
- "Transparent unit economics — token-level cost breakdowns + auto-batching suggestions."
- "Unified API — ship once, run anywhere (hosted, dedicated, private)."
```
Maya L: Nice start. Make one variant that leans technical (for SEs) and one that is benefits-first (for SDRs).
Rohan S: I'll create two subject-line groups for the webinar invite: A: "Reduce inference cost per query by 3x" and B: "Keep latency predictable at scale — demo". A/B test on the top 200 accounts.
Avery K: For SDR scripts: give me 3 short openers + 1-line micro-case study. Example: "We helped X drop inference cost 2.6x while keeping 99ms p95" — is that defensible?
Samir: We can defend with anonymized meta metrics — willing to say range (2–3x). Also call out fallback policies if capacity constrained.
benchbot: New benchmark report uploaded: /bench/production/p95-cost-compare-2026-03-21.pdf (summary: cost gap vs cloud endpoints at p95 workloads).
Maya L: Action items:
- Maya: write 12 SDR openers + 6 micro-case studies (due Tue EOD)
- Jules: update the counterclaim matrix and add tech/benefit variants (due Wed)
- Rohan: set up the A/B on webinar subject lines (start Mon)
- Samir: gather procurement FAQs + pricing comms (end of week)
Avery K: I'll run a 15-min playtest with two SDRs Wed morning and report picks.
Jules P: Also add a tiny cheatsheet for SEs: 3 short demo prompts to show caching & fallback in 2 minutes. Keep it copy-paste.
Maya L: Perfect. One more ask — can someone draft two single-slide benchmarks comparing cost & p95 latency vs cloud endpoints? Need for sales decks.
Rohan S: I'll do the slides and put source links.
Maya L: Thanks all. If anyone sees a hard objection that doesn't map neatly, drop it in this thread and we'll slot it into the matrix. :thumbsup:
